title: Ìjìnlẹ̀ ni ìfẹ́ Jésù
title_en: O the Deep, Deep Love of Jesus
review_notes: The printed edition shows two verses. Yoruba orthography and some words require checking. English counterpart is public domain.
verses: Ó ga púpọ̀, ó fẹ̀ ńlá
Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìfẹ́ Rẹ sí mi
Ní mo ń rí ìfẹ́ Rẹ yìí
Ó ń lọ mí lọ l'ọ̀nà ìyè
Títí n ó dé ilé mi.
Bí ìfẹ́ Rẹ ti tóbi lọ
Tó ti ń fẹ́, tí kì í rẹ̀
Ó ń bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún wọn lórí ìtẹ́
Ó ń pa wọ́n mọ́ látòkè.
verses_en: O the deep, deep love of Jesus
Is the current of Thy love
O the deep, deep love of Jesus
Spread His praise from shore to shore
How He loves us, ever loves us
How He watches over loved ones
Died to call them all His own
